{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique values in 'site' and 'arm' to confirm structure
print('Unique sites:', df['site'].unique())
print('Unique arms:', df['arm'].unique())

# Check response rate by site
response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rates by site:\n', response_rates)

# Identify the site with the highest response rate
max_site = response_rates.idxmax()
max_rate = response_rates.max()

print(f'\nSite with highest response rate: {max_site} ({max_rate:.3f})')"}
